title: Videos and match analysis | Kaderblick Docs

hero.heading: Videos and match analysis
hero.lead: Videos always belong to a specific match. In the video area, you record the source and timing; during playback, Kaderblick connects video time, match events and marked scenes.

body:
Open the video area

  1. Open Matches.
  2. Select the relevant match.
  3. Open Videos. The number beside the heading is the count of recorded videos.

Add a video

Select Add video. The editor contains:

  • Name: unique label in the video list.
  • YouTube link or file URL: source that Kaderblick should open for playback.
  • File path: optional additional path shown in the video list.
  • Start time: position at which the match begins in the video. Enter seconds, mm:ss or hh:mm:ss.
  • Order: position when several videos exist.
  • Video type: required selection for the video type maintained in Kaderblick.
  • Camera: optional assignment of the camera perspective.
  • Duration: total duration in seconds, mm:ss or hh:mm:ss.

Select Add to assign the video to the match. Cancel closes the dialogue without applying it.

Use an existing video

Each entry shows its name and, where present, preview image, video type, duration, camera and file path. Select the name, preview or YouTube icon to open the player. Users with management permission also receive Edit and Delete.

Match time and video time

The start time connects the video timeline to match time. If kick-off is at 1:30 in the video, that position represents the beginning of match time. Kaderblick applies this offset when jumping to events. With several consecutive videos, it also considers the order and duration of preceding videos.

Events and timeline

The player timeline displays recorded match events at the corresponding video position. You can jump to an event. With the relevant event permission, events can be created at the current video position or corrected in time. On mobile devices, separate controls are available for playback, one- or five-second jumps, event positioning and cut markers.

Video scenes and cut markers

Once at least one video exists, Video scenes appears. It manages clips for each video with a start position, duration, title, subtitle, audio option and order. Existing scenes can be edited, deleted and exported as CSV.

In the player, you can enable cut mode, set the beginning and end of a scene and move or fine-tune its marker on the timeline. Kaderblick shows the number and total duration of cut markers.

Access by role and relation

  • Users with read access: see and play existing videos.
  • Approved supporter or team manager: can manage videos and match events depending on the specific match permission.
  • Supporter without team permission: receives Request supporter rights instead of the editor. An open request shows the club, team and request date.
  • System role alone: does not guarantee video access. Permission for the participating team and specific match is decisive.

Connections to cameras and software

Recording, transfer and preparation are explained in the retained Camera systems and Video Manager areas. The prepared source is then assigned to the match as a video.
